Incineroar stands out for Intimidate, Fake Out, and Parting Shot utility, and I'm thinking through how Kingambit and Gholdengo fit against their Sylveon and the rest of their lineup.

Working through the type matchups more—Electric only does neutral damage to Rotom-Wash since Water isn't weak to it, but Archaludon's Draco Meteor hits Dragonite super effectively, and Flash Cannon handles Sylveon well too.

I'll settle on Incineroar, Gholdengo, and Archaludon as my team, leading with Incineroar.
